extracted.name: French Cream Mushroom Soup
extracted.description: Really good French cream of mushroom soup. Goes on the chicken tourtes.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over low heat. Caramelize onions for 45 min.
Add garlic, cook 1-2 min until fragrant.
Add olive oil and Bella mushrooms. Sauté on high, stirring, 15-20 min.
Stir in truffle purée. Deglaze with white wine, cook 5 min.
Mix in flour. Pour in chicken stock, bring to a boil to thicken.
Return to pot. Stir in cream, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper.
